name: Input Buffer
description: Delays your clicks by a set number of ticks so early inputs still land.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn the input buffer on or off.

delay-ticks.name: Buffer (ticks)
delay-ticks.description: How many physics ticks each click waits before it is actually input. GD runs at 240 ticks per second by default, so 1 tick is about 4.2 ms and 12 ticks is about 50 ms. 0 = no delay.

affect-movement.name: Also buffer left/right (platformer)
affect-movement.description: Also delay the left and right buttons in platformer levels. Off by default, so only the jump button is buffered.
